Record Class ZipEntryInfo

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
io.micronaut.runner.build.ZipEntryInfo
Record Components:
name - the entry name, that is, the path inside the archive, using '/' separators; a directory entry's name ends with '/'
method - the compression method, IndexFormat.METHOD_STORED or IndexFormat.METHOD_DEFLATED
compressedSize - the number of bytes of entry data physically present in the archive
uncompressedSize - the size of the entry's content once decompressed
crc32 - the CRC-32 of the uncompressed content, as an unsigned 32-bit value
dosTime - the MS-DOS date and time as stored in the ZIP header, the date in the high 16 bits and the time in the low 16 bits, which is the layout IndexFormat.E_DOS_TIME expects
localHeaderOffset - the offset of the entry's local file header, relative to the start of the archive
dataOffset - the offset of the entry's first data byte, that is, past the local file header, its name and its extra field, relative to the start of the archive
directory - whether the entry is a directory
public record ZipEntryInfo(String name, int method, long compressedSize, long uncompressedSize, long crc32, int dosTime, long localHeaderOffset, long dataOffset, boolean directory) extends Record
An immutable description of one entry of a ZIP archive, as the packaging library needs it.

This is deliberately not ZipEntry: the runner jar format indexes entry data by absolute file offset and the launcher reads it with no ZIP parsing at all, so the packager needs the two offsets the JDK never exposes: the offset of the entry's local file header and the offset of its first data byte. The latter cannot be derived from the central directory alone, because the name and extra field lengths of the local header may differ from the ones in the central directory record; it is resolved by ZipReader from the local header itself.

All numeric fields hold the values as stored in the archive, widened to signed Java types so that unsigned 32-bit values and ZIP64 64-bit values survive: sizes and offsets are long and crc32() is a long holding an unsigned 32-bit value, exactly like ZipEntry.getCrc().

Since:
1.0

    • ZipEntryInfo

      public ZipEntryInfo(String name, int method, long compressedSize, long uncompressedSize, long crc32, int dosTime, long localHeaderOffset, long dataOffset, boolean directory)
      Validates the invariants every reader and writer in this library relies on.
      Parameters:
      name - the entry name
      method - the compression method
      compressedSize - the stored size
      uncompressedSize - the size of the content
      crc32 - the CRC-32 of the content
      dosTime - the MS-DOS date and time
      localHeaderOffset - the offset of the local file header
      dataOffset - the offset of the first data byte
      directory - whether the entry is a directory
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if name is null
      IllegalArgumentException - if a size, an offset or the CRC-32 is out of range

  • Method Details

    • stored

      public boolean stored()
      Whether the entry data is stored uncompressed, in which case the bytes between dataOffset() and dataOffset() + compressedSize() are the content itself. This is what lets the launcher define a class straight from a memory-mapped slice of the outer archive.
      Returns:
      true when the compression method is IndexFormat.METHOD_STORED

    • shift

      public ZipEntryInfo shift(long delta)
      Returns a copy of this entry with both offsets moved by delta bytes.

      ZipRepacker reports offsets relative to the start of the nested jar it produced. The packager turns them into the absolute offsets the index stores by shifting them with the offset at which that nested jar was written into the outer archive.

      Parameters:
      delta - the number of bytes to add to localHeaderOffset() and dataOffset()
      Returns:
      the shifted entry, or this instance when delta is zero
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the shift would make an offset negative
